mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_payment_sub_ship_info ( payment_sub_info_id, mb_id, it_id, ad_id, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, od_memo, od_send_cost,od_send_cost2,od_shop_memo, od_cart_count, create_id ) SELECT #{paymentSubInfoId}, #{mbId}, #{itId}, #{adId}, gsoa.ad_name, gm.mb_email, gsoa.ad_tel, gsoa.ad_hp, gsoa.ad_zip1, gsoa.ad_zip2, gsoa.ad_addr1, gsoa.ad_addr2, gsoa.ad_addr3, gsoa.ad_jibeon, gsoa.ad_name, gsoa.ad_tel, gsoa.ad_hp, gsoa.ad_zip1, gsoa.ad_zip2, gsoa.ad_addr1, gsoa.ad_addr2, gsoa.ad_addr3, gsoa.ad_jibeon, #{odMemo}, #{odSendCost}, #{odSendCost2}, '정기결제', #{odCartCount}, #{mbId} FROM g5_member gm INNER JOIN g5_shop_order_address gsoa ON gm.mb_id = gsoa.mb_id WHERE gm.mb_id = #{mbId} AND gsoa.ad_id = #{adId}

INSERT INTO pet_payment_sub_ship_info_history ( payment_sub_info_id, sub_ship_info_id, mb_id, it_id, ad_id, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, od_memo, od_send_cost,od_send_cost2,od_shop_memo, od_cart_count, create_id ) SELECT payment_sub_info_id, sub_ship_info_id, mb_id, it_id, #{adId}, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, #{odMemo}, #{odSendCost}, #{odSendCost2}, '정기결제', #{odCartCount}, mb_id FROM pet_payment_sub_ship_info WHERE sub_ship_info_id = #{subShipInfoId}

INSERT INTO pet_payment_sub_cart_info ( sub_ship_info_id, payment_sub_info_id, mb_id, it_id, ct_option, ct_send_cost, ct_qty, io_id, io_type, io_price, ct_price, it_sc_type, it_sc_method, it_sc_price, it_sc_minimum, it_sc_qty, pet_id, pet_history_id, urine_check_history_id, create_id )VALUES ( #{subShipInfoId}, #{paymentSubInfoId}, #{mbId}, #{itId}, #{ctOption}, #{ctSendCost}, #{ctQty}, #{ioId}, #{ioType}, #{ioPrice}, #{ctPrice}, #{itScType}, #{itScMethod}, #{itScPrice}, #{itScMinimum}, #{itScQty}, #{petId}, CASE WHEN #{petId} = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT pih.pet_history_id FROM pet_info_history pih WHERE pih.pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY pih.create_ymd DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) END, CASE WHEN #{urineCheckId} = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT uch.urine_check_history_id FROM pet_urine_check_history uch WHERE uch.urine_check_id = #{urineCheckId} ORDER BY uch.create_ymd DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) END, #{mbId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_payment_sub_ship_info ppshi JOIN g5_member gm ON ppshi.mb_id = gm.mb_id JOIN g5_shop_order_address gsoa ON gm.mb_id = gsoa.mb_id AND gsoa.ad_id = #{adId} SET ppshi.ad_id = #{adId}, ppshi.od_name = gm.mb_name, ppshi.od_email = gm.mb_email, ppshi.od_tel = gsoa.ad_tel, ppshi.od_hp = gsoa.ad_hp, ppshi.od_zip1 = gsoa.ad_zip1, ppshi.od_zip2 = gsoa.ad_zip2, ppshi.od_addr1 = gsoa.ad_addr1, ppshi.od_addr2 = gsoa.ad_addr2, ppshi.od_addr3 = gsoa.ad_addr3, ppshi.od_addr_jibeon = gsoa.ad_jibeon, ppshi.od_b_name = gsoa.ad_name, ppshi.od_b_tel = gsoa.ad_tel, ppshi.od_b_hp = gsoa.ad_hp, ppshi.od_b_zip1 = gsoa.ad_zip1, ppshi.od_b_zip2 = gsoa.ad_zip2, ppshi.od_b_addr1 = gsoa.ad_addr1, ppshi.od_b_addr2 = gsoa.ad_addr2, ppshi.od_b_addr3 = gsoa.ad_addr3, ppshi.od_b_addr_jibeon = gsoa.ad_jibeon, ppshi.od_memo = #{odMemo}, ppshi.od_send_cost = #{odSendCost}, ppshi.od_send_cost2 = #{odSendCost2}, ppshi.od_shop_memo = '정기결제', ppshi.od_cart_count = #{odCartCount}, ppshi.update_id = #{mbId}, ppshi.update_ymd = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ppshi.sub_ship_info_id = #{subShipInfoId}

UPDATE pet_payment_sub_info SET payment_period_cd_id = #{paymentPeriodCdId}, payment_start_day = #{paymentStartDay}, payment_period_cd_id = #{paymentPeriodCdId}, update_id = #{mbId}, update_ymd = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_sub_info_id = #{paymentSubInfoId} AND del_fl = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_payment_sub_ship_info_history ( payment_sub_info_id, sub_ship_info_id, mb_id, it_id, ad_id, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, od_memo, od_send_cost,od_send_cost2,od_shop_memo, od_cart_count, pet_id,pet_history_id,urine_check_history_id, create_id ) SELECT payment_sub_info_id, sub_ship_info_id, mb_id, it_id, #{adId}, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, #{odMemo}, #{odSendCost}, #{odSendCost2}, '정기결제', #{odCartCount}, pet_id, pet_history_id, urine_check_history_id, mb_id FROM pet_payment_sub_ship_info WHERE sub_ship_info_id = #{subShipInfoId}

INSERT INTO g5_shop_cart ( od_id, mb_id, it_id, it_name, it_sc_type, it_sc_method, it_sc_price, it_sc_minimum, it_sc_qty, ct_status, ct_history, ct_price, ct_point, cp_price, ct_point_use, ct_stock_use, ct_option, ct_qty, ct_notax, io_id, io_type, io_price, ct_time, ct_ip, ct_send_cost, ct_direct, ct_select, ct_select_time, pet_id, pet_history_id, urine_check_history_id ) SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), LPAD(SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%f'), 1, 2), 2, '0') ) ELSE od_id END FROM g5_shop_cart WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND ct_status = '쇼핑' ORDER BY ct_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS od_id, #{mbId} AS mb_id, pssi.it_id, g5si.it_name, g5si.it_sc_type, g5si.it_sc_method, g5si.it_sc_price, g5si.it_sc_minimum, g5si.it_sc_qty, '입금' AS ct_status, '정기결제' AS ct_history, g5si.it_price AS ct_price, 0 AS ct_point, 0 AS cp_price, 0 AS ct_point_use, 0 AS ct_stock_use, g5si.it_name AS ct_option, pssi.od_cart_count AS ct_qty, g5si.it_notax AS ct_notax, '' AS io_id, 0 AS io_type, 0 AS io_price, NOW() AS ct_time, '' AS ct_ip, g5si.it_sc_method AS ct_send_cost, 1 AS ct_direct, 1 AS ct_select, NOW() AS ct_select_time, pssi.pet_id, pssi.pet_history_id, pssi.urine_check_history_id FROM pet_payment_sub_ship_info pssi INNER JOIN g5_shop_item g5si ON g5si.it_id = pssi.it_id WHERE pssi.payment_sub_info_id = #{paymentSubInfoId} AND pssi.del_fl = 0;

INSERT INTO g5_shop_order ( od_id, mb_id, payment_sub_info_id, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, od_deposit_name, od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, od_memo, od_cart_count, od_cart_price, od_cart_coupon, od_send_cost, od_send_cost2, od_send_coupon, od_receipt_price, od_cancel_price, od_receipt_point, od_refund_price, od_bank_account, od_receipt_time, od_coupon, od_event_coupon, od_misu, od_shop_memo, od_mod_history, od_status, od_hope_date, od_settle_case, od_other_pay_type, od_test, od_mobile, od_pg, od_tno, od_app_no, od_escrow, od_casseqno, od_tax_flag, od_tax_mny, od_vat_mny, od_free_mny, od_delivery_company, od_invoice, od_invoice_time, od_cash, od_cash_no, od_cash_info, od_time, od_pwd, od_ip, subscribe_amount ) SELECT #{odId} AS od_id, #{mbId} AS mb_id, #{paymentSubInfoId} AS payment_sub_info_id, od_name, od_email, od_tel, od_hp, od_zip1, od_zip2, od_addr1, od_addr2, od_addr3, od_addr_jibeon, '', od_b_name, od_b_tel, od_b_hp, od_b_zip1, od_b_zip2, od_b_addr1, od_b_addr2, od_b_addr3, od_b_addr_jibeon, od_memo, od_cart_count, #{odCartPrice} AS od_cart_price, 0 AS od_cart_coupon, od_send_cost, od_send_cost2, 0 AS od_send_coupon, #{odReceiptPrice} AS od_receipt_price, 0 AS od_cancel_price, 0 AS od_receipt_point, 0 AS od_refund_price, '' AS od_bank_account, NOW() AS od_receipt_time, 0 AS od_coupon, 0 AS od_event_coupon, 0 AS od_misu, '정기결제' AS od_shop_memo, '' AS od_mod_history, '입금' AS od_status, '0000-00-00' AS od_hope_date, '신용카드' AS od_settle_case, '' AS od_other_pay_type, #{odTest} AS od_test, 0 AS od_mobile, 'inicis' AS od_pg, #{odTNo} AS od_tno, #{odAppNo} AS od_app_no, 0 AS od_escrow, '' AS od_casseqno, 0 AS od_tax_flag, ROUND(#{odReceiptPrice} / 1.1) AS od_tax_mny, #{odReceiptPrice} - ROUND(#{odReceiptPrice} / 1.1) AS od_vat_mny, 0 AS od_free_mny, 'CJ' AS od_delivery_company, '' AS od_invoice, '0000-00-00 00:00:00' AS od_invoice_time, 0 AS od_cash, '' AS od_cash_no, '' AS od_cash_info, NOW() AS od_time, '' AS od_pwd, '' AS od_ip, #{subscribeAmount} FROM pet_payment_sub_ship_info WHERE payment_sub_info_id = #{paymentSubInfoId} AND del_fl = 0

INSERT INTO pet_payment_history (mb_id, payment_type, amount, imp_uid, it_id, od_id, status, message, pay_method, card_name, card_number, pay_location, create_id) VALUES (#{mbId}, #{paymentType}, #{amount}, #{impUid}, #{itId}, #{odId}, #{status}, #{message}, #{payMethod}, #{cardName}, #{cardNumber}, #{payLocation}, #{mbId})
mapper.select: SELECT code_type, code_value, code_nm FROM pet_payment_ship_code WHERE del_fl = 0 AND code = 'COUNT_DISCOUNT' AND code_type = ( SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM pet_payment_history WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND status = 1 AND payment_type = 2 AND del_fl = 0 );
SELECT od_id FROM g5_shop_cart WHERE ct_id = #{ctId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: update pet_payment_sub_info SET payment_last_day = CURRENT_DATE WHERE payment_sub_info_id = #{paymentSubInfoId} AND del_fl = 0
mapper.select: SELECT gso.od_id, gso.od_status, gso.od_receipt_price, gso.od_pg, gso.od_app_no, gso.od_shop_memo, gso.od_settle_case, gso.od_bank_account, GROUP_CONCAT(gsc.ct_id SEPARATOR ',') AS ct_id, GROUP_CONCAT(gsc.it_id SEPARATOR ',') AS it_id FROM g5_shop_order gso LEFT JOIN g5_shop_cart gsc ON gsc.od_id = gso.od_id AND gsc.mb_id = gso.mb_id WHERE gso.od_id = #{odId} GROUP BY gso.od_id
